latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert study notes into explainer videos effortlessly.

- Upload text notes (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MD, up to 50MB) and generate 1080p MP4 videos with narration and visuals
- Automatic cloud session setup: handles token generation, session management, and file uploads
- Supports user prompts for editing, exporting, checking credits, and managing timeline state
- Fast video rendering (1–2 minutes) with downloadable results
- Clear file type and size support, helpful error guidance, and seamless workflows for study content creation
